definitions.explanation: A ring given as a symbol of a marriage engagement. In Japan, diamond rings became standard from the mid-20th century under Western influence.

examples.japanese: {婚約指輪|こんやくゆびわ}を{贈|おく}る。
{彼|かれ}は{婚約指輪|こんやくゆびわ}を{選|えら}ぶのに{何|なん}{週間|しゅうかん}もかけた。
examples.english: He spent weeks choosing the engagement ring.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はダイヤモンドの{婚約指輪|こんやくゆびわ}を{左手|ひだりて}の{薬指|くすりゆび}にはめていた。
examples.english: She was wearing a diamond engagement ring on the ring finger of her left hand.

notes:
Compound of {婚約|こんやく} (engagement) and {指輪|ゆびわ} (ring). Often abbreviated to エンゲージリング in casual speech, borrowing from English.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {婚約指輪|こんやくゆびわ}を{贈|おく}る — to give an engagement ring
- {婚約指輪|こんやくゆびわ}を{選|えら}ぶ — to choose an engagement ring
- {婚約指輪|こんやくゆびわ}をはめる — to put on an engagement ring
- {婚約指輪|こんやくゆびわ}の{相場|そうば} — the going price for engagement rings

RELATED TERMS:
- {結婚指輪|けっこんゆびわ}: wedding ring — exchanged at the wedding ceremony
- エンゲージリング: engagement ring — loanword alternative
- {婚約|こんやく}: engagement
